zapier.name: Zapier
zapier.summary: Use the apps and actions connected to your own Zapier account.
zapier.setup: In Zapier MCP, add a server for Other, open Connect, and generate a connection token. Copy the token itself into DGC. Manage your apps and tools in Zapier.

make.name: Make
make.summary: Run the scenarios you configure in your Make account.
make.setup: Connect your Make account in the browser and choose the organization and scopes. The Run your scenarios scope covers its active and on-demand scenarios. Manage scenarios and app credentials in Make.

n8n.name: n8n
n8n.summary: Use selected workflows on n8n Cloud or your own n8n instance.
n8n.setup: In your n8n instance, enable Settings → Instance-level MCP, expose the workflows you want to use, and copy the server URL. Choose browser sign-in or a personal access token. With Remote SSH, local addresses refer to the machine running DGC.

arcade.name: Arcade
arcade.summary: Connect a gateway containing the tools you select in Arcade.
arcade.setup: Create an MCP Gateway in Arcade, select Arcade Auth and the tools to expose, then copy its gateway URL. Sign in with your own Arcade account. Manage tools and provider authorization in Arcade. This setup supports Arcade Cloud gateways.

asana.name: Asana

steps: In Asana's developer console, choose Create new app. Name it DGC, set the app type to MCP app, and create it.
Under OAuth, add this redirect URL: {redirect}
Under Manage distribution, choose Specific workspaces, add your workspace, and save.
Copy the app's client ID and client secret into the fields below.

asana.summary: Your Asana tasks, projects and goals, through an Asana app you create for DGC.
asana.setup: Asana's MCP server admits only apps registered in Asana, so you create one for DGC in your own Asana account. It takes about two minutes, and it is the setup Asana documents for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and VS Code.

docusign.name: Docusign

demo.label: Developer account (demo)
demo.note: A free Docusign developer account works straight away.

production.label: Production account
production.note: A production account accepts the app only after it passes Docusign's Go-Live review and your Docusign admin approves it for MCP. Add the redirect URI and a secret key in the production account's Apps and Keys too.

own_app.console_label: Open Apps and Keys in Docusign
steps: In Apps and Keys, choose Add App and Integration Key, and name it DGC.
Under Authentication, choose User Application: Yes (Authorization Code Grant), then Add Secret Key. Copy the secret key now: Docusign shows it once.
Under Additional settings, add this redirect URI: {redirect} Save. Docusign can take up to five minutes to apply it.
Copy the integration key and the secret key into the fields below.

docusign.summary: Envelopes, agreements and templates in your Docusign account, through a Docusign app you create for DGC.
docusign.setup: Docusign's MCP server admits only apps that hold a secret key, so you create one for DGC in your Docusign account. It is the setup Docusign documents for VS Code and other MCP clients.
